scope: The 160 originally correct fixed-test examples that regressed after diverse training and anchoring. All labels remain frozen.
interpretation: The mutually exclusive mechanisms describe inference decisions, not mutually exclusive training root causes.
157 were already wrong before anchoring; only 3 regressions were introduced by anchoring. All 160 reproduce through the real asynchronous Wime client.
120 correct strings remain in the identical initial dictionary pool; all 160 are dictionary-reachable.
149 old-versus-new unanchored joint-score preferences flip on the same correct/incorrect pair.

22 chat cases have at least one contrasting target phrase present in original training but absent from sampled replay. Counts are raw prepared-row coverage, before augmentation and stochastic batch sampling; they do not establish causation for every case.
8 manually flagged label/intent ambiguities are kept in every metric. No labels were changed or added to training.
105 regressions differ by one character. Lower average token loss does not imply better whole-composition top-1 ranking.

wide_search.scope: Post-hoc diagnostic on these regressions, not a global accuracy or a chosen deployment setting.

training_control.loss: Cross-entropy on all target tokens; reference KL only on primary replay batches and supervised output positions.

development_selection.criterion: Equal old/new domain accuracy, no old-dev loss relative to baseline. Original frozen tests were not evaluated for these rejected checkpoints.

weight_interpolation.selection: mean of old/new domain accuracy; old-dev accuracy >= current; N-best only

log_score_ensemble.selection: Equal old/new domain accuracy, no old-dev loss relative to current; frozen candidate pools; no test access

probability_ensemble.selection: Equal old/new domain accuracy, no old-dev loss relative to current; per-token probability mixture; frozen dev pools only

confidence_prior_selection.selection: Equal old/new accuracy, old no lower than baseline, same dev pools; syllable counts from literal input, no label in prediction
